shots.focal_element: Soft glowing edge of a rounded, rose-tinted surface catching a bright horizontal light band
shots.transition_other: opening shot: anchors give no transition; frames go from pure black (0.0 s) to the lit 3D scene (0.5 s), consistent with a fade or cut up from black
shots.what_happens: The video opens on black, then a macro 3D environment of smooth rose-coloured curved forms appears, with a bright light streak at the horizon behind a rounded edge.
shots.build_rebuild: Start on a black frame and fade to a low, close 3D camera next to a rounded matte object with an HDR light strip behind it, with heavy depth of field and bloom.

shots.focal_element: Rounded vertical edge of a large satin-finish form with a blown-out light corridor beyond it
shots.what_happens: The camera glides slowly along the foot of a large rounded form toward a bright light band, then the view turns to show a curved stepped wall in close-up; the abstract, microscopic scale hides what the object is.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a slow dolly past a filleted 3D block on a glossy floor toward an emissive horizon strip, using shallow depth of field and motion blur so that form and light read as one smear.

shots.focal_element: Gap of light between a curved, banded wall on the left and a dark rounded pillar on the right
shots.what_happens: A low tracking shot moves through a narrow channel between a lit curved wall and a shadowed rounded pillar toward a bright opening; by the end the camera pushes past the pillar into a light-streaked opening.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a low camera between two filleted 3D forms, one lit and one in shadow, and push it toward the bright gap between them, timed so the forms fill the frame at the end of the shot.

shots.focal_element: Large blurred rounded mass in the left two-thirds, with a sweeping curved ribbon edge and light streaks on the right
shots.what_happens: The longest shot in this part: the camera slowly orbits a soft rounded mass while a curved ribbon-like edge sweeps overhead and streaks of light rush along the floor toward the horizon.
shots.build_rebuild: Orbit a 3D camera slowly around a large rounded form for about 3.7 s, with a curved sheet arching overhead and emissive streak lines on a reflective floor, plus strong foreground defocus.

shots.focal_element: Short cylinder with a fine mesh or perforated surface, standing on a reflective floor right of centre
shots.what_happens: A wide view of a vast rose-tinted space with a low ceiling and a bright horizon band; a small textured cylinder, possibly a macro view of a hardware component, stands on the glossy floor while the camera drifts and a rounded form slides into the left edge.
shots.build_rebuild: Frame a small mesh-textured cylinder on the right third of a glossy floor under a low curved ceiling with a white horizon strip, and drift the camera sideways so a blurred foreground form slides in from the left.

shots.focal_element: The same mesh-textured cylinder, now centre-right, framed by a curved wall on the left
shots.what_happens: After a crossfade, the camera holds a similar view of the mesh cylinder from a slightly different angle; the exposure settles from bright and hazy to deeper and more saturated, with curved forms closing in at the top corners.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade to a second angle of the same cylinder set, and animate exposure and bloom down over about 1 s while blurred foreground forms creep into the top corners.
